name: handbook
description: A small hand-written employee-handbook corpus. Fifteen questions covering direct lookup, paraphrase, multi-document synthesis, and four the corpus deliberately cannot answer. Small on purpose: twenty questions someone actually cares about find more than two hundred paraphrases of each other, and a set a human can read in one sitting is a set a human will keep honest.

documents.title: expenses-policy.md
documents.content:
Expense reimbursement

Expenses are reimbursed monthly, provided an itemised receipt is attached to the claim form. Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense being incurred; anything older is refused automatically and requires a written exception from a director.

Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to 45 pounds per day. Alcohol is never reimbursed, including when it appears on an otherwise valid meal receipt.

Any single expense above 500 pounds requires prior written approval from a line manager before the money is spent. Approval obtained afterwards does not count, and the claim will be refused.

documents.title: leave-policy.md
documents.content:
Annual leave and holiday

Holiday requests must be approved by a line manager at least two weeks ahead of the intended dates. Requests covering more than ten consecutive working days need a second approval from a director.

Every employee receives 28 days of paid annual leave per year, inclusive of public holidays. Up to five unused days may be carried into the following year; anything beyond five is lost on 31 December.

Sick leave is separate from annual leave and is not capped, but absences longer than seven consecutive days require a doctor's note.

documents.title: equipment-policy.md
documents.content:
Equipment and workspace

Every employee is issued a laptop on their first day. Replacement is on a three-year cycle, or sooner if the machine fails and cannot be economically repaired.

A home-office budget of 400 pounds is available in an employee's first year, and 150 pounds each year after that. It covers desks, chairs, monitors and lighting. It does not cover consumables such as paper or ink.

Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT within 24 hours so the device can be remotely wiped.

documents.title: facilities.md
documents.content:
Office facilities

The office plants are watered every Tuesday by the facilities team. Please do not water them yourself; overwatering has killed more plants here than neglect.

Meeting rooms are booked through the shared calendar. A room held but unused for fifteen minutes is released automatically.

The kitchen is restocked on Monday and Thursday mornings.
